states.instruction: Confirm actual character appearance.
Select one of the three source experience choices.
Speak to the Gielinor Guide; introducing settings is a real dialogue.
Open Settings, not merely click the guide again.
Hear guide's explanation and permission to use the door.
Walk to and pass the indicated eastern door.
Receive a small fishing net from the Survival Expert.
Open inventory to view the net.
Actually catch raw shrimps using the net.
Open Skills after the catch.
Receive bronze axe and tinderbox after the skill explanation.
Actually chop a normal tree using the bronze axe.
Use tinderbox/logs to successfully create a real fire.
Cook raw shrimps on a fire. Source accepts a resolved burn as well as success.
Use the western gate after the cooking attempt.
Reach and enter the Chef's kitchen via its real door.
Receive flour and water from the Master Chef.
Combine pot of flour and bucket of water into dough.
Use the range for a real bread cooking attempt.
Leave through the north-west door.
Use the run orb; running still consumes real energy.
Follow the path and enter the Quest Guide house.
Talk to the Quest Guide and start tracked Learning the Ropes.
Open Quest List/journal.
Hear the explanation of not-started, active and complete quests.
Descend the actual ladder to the dungeon.
Receive bronze pickaxe and mining instruction.
Mine an actual tin or copper ore. Tin is prompted first.
Mine until currently holding one of each ore.
Use the furnace; consume tin+copper and make bronze.
Talk to the instructor for hammer and smithing explanation.
Open the smithing interface at an actual anvil.
Select and actually smith a bronze dagger.
Pass the mining-to-combat gate.
Talk to Vannaka about wielding equipment.
Open Worn Equipment.
Open the shield/helmet Equipment Stats button.
Equip the dagger using real inventory/slot ownership.
Receive sword/shield, with explicit partial grants if space is limited.
Equip bronze sword and wooden shield; replace dagger.
Open Combat Options; preserve source styles and XP selection.
Pass through the pen gate with instructor permission.
Kill one tutorial rat using actual melee combat; tutorial cannot kill the player.
Leave the pen and return to Vannaka.
Receive shortbow and 50 bronze arrows; one free slot yields bow alone.
Equip shortbow and ammunition; a bow must displace weapon AND shield.
Kill a second rat with ranged from outside the pen.
Climb the eastern ladder after both combat lessons.
Open the bank booth; first bank already has 25 coins.
Use real banking if desired, then close it.
Inspect the poll booth and explanation; do not fabricate a vote.
Pass the eastern door only after bank and poll inspection.
Talk to Account Guide.
Open Account Management.
Hear membership/worlds/bonds/inbox/security explanation; demonstrated tabs actually open.
Pass the eastern exit.
Walk to and enter the chapel.
Talk to Brother Brace.
Open Prayer.
Hear activation, draining, altar recharge and burying bones. Actually praying/burying is optional.
Leave the chapel by its southern door.
Follow the real path to the Magic Instructor; Ironman information is optional for normal accounts.
Talk to Terrova.
Open spellbook; initial list is filtered by available Magic level.
Receive five air and five mind runes.
Select Wind Strike and target a tutorial chicken; actually cast once.
Learning the Ropes is complete and pays 1 QP; still on island until authorized departure.
Confirm mainland travel and normal-account status, or ask about Ironman and return later.
Cast real Lumbridge Home Teleport; no runes, no XP, not an instant stage command.
Complete default 24-tick Home Teleport or retry after interruption.
Arrive on the selected experience branch with reconciled possessions; tutorial is permanently complete.

grant_definitions.policy: one_initial; missing-only replacement per recovery policy
one_initial_each; all-or-none unless both missing replacements fit
missing_each_only while dough/bread absent and lesson not exited; never duplicate the present ingredient
one_initial; missing-only replacement per recovery policy
missing_bow_first; top_up_total_inventory_plus_equipped_arrows_to_50; 1 free slot with neither grants bow_only; existing arrow stack needs no free slot

recovery_handlers.scope: after original grant unlock, before departure, owning instructor reachable
recovery_handlers.policy: Return only each missing unlocked tool. Full inventory: explicit refusal, unchanged stage; nearby dropped tools may be picked up first.

recovery_handlers.scope: Master Chef lesson, no dough/bread; even if stage is bake_bread and dough was lost
recovery_handlers.policy: Replenish only missing flour/water; actually remake dough and bake. Losing inputs never completes the lesson.

Unlocked earlier activities remain usable on their reachable tutorial objects until departure; a lost ore/bar/dagger must be mined/smelted/smithed again. Reopen smithing UI if needed. Hammer replacement does not mint a bar. Last-resort instructor dagger replacement is provisional, not used by ordinary journey fixtures.

recovery_handlers.scope: after original respective lesson grant, before corresponding required kill
recovery_handlers.policy: Count equipped items as owned; fill only missing gear and arrows up to 50; never grant after every attack. One-slot partial grants persist across retries.
If air>=1 and mind>=1, instructor refuses more. Otherwise top up each to 5 if resulting stacks fit. Exact asymmetric depleted-rune count is not in source; do not label the top-up as verified.

action_unlock_limits: Sticky unlocks do not override source area/object restrictions, level caps, equipment requirements or rat/chicken repeat-action guards. Returning to an earlier workshop uses real travel. Mainland removes tutorial-specific locks, not ordinary level/quest requirements.
source_progress_policy: All numeric values are intentionally null. No source numeric stage/varp was established by these public transcripts.
entry_guards: Entry to the graph requires a new persisted normal account, not a test seed.
Each noninitial state requires its immediately preceding transition or a persisted acknowledged checkpoint; stage numbers are never accepted as player commands.
Result events require the shared system's actual item/tool/level/range/LOS/timing checks. A graph match alone is insufficient.
UI unlocks on state entry persist. Refresh/reconnect projects the same state and does not run grants again.
dialogue_policy: Topics are semantic/paraphrased beats, not purported exact source strings. Required dialogue must actually be completed; recap loops and rejected earlier actions do not progress. Presentation text, timing, highlighting, chatheads and audio still need the approved reference pack.

bank_seed_hook.note: Seeding, first bank opening and stage acknowledgement are one transaction.

optional_controls.run_gate_caveat: The transcript describes a run prompt and the after-toggle prompt, but not a refusal when walking to the next door. Requiring the demonstrated toggle is a labeled graph inference, not a captured source door lock.

journey_evidence: Structural reachability is not a passed journey. All live/headless acceptance runs must emit the full real event trace.
